correctness.rationale: All graph edges and all matching faces are enumerated by a complete finite algorithm. Exact gradient acyclicity checks cover 21504/17498/3092 directed face incidences; the signed integral Morse boundary has unimodular full-row-rank minors in three cases. Hurewicz and CW cancellation produce the three claimed sphere wedges. The 48 explicit coordinate automorphisms act transitively on graph edges, and the cone attachment splits because the link-to-deletion map is null-homotopic. A separate implementation checks the full simplicial homology over fields of characteristics two and three. See executable files and captured output.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural edge-local homotopy classification for a canonical edge-transitive but non-outerplanar polyhedral graph, not a single unmotivated numerical parameter. All 24 graph-edge deletions and links are explicitly classified and yield the structural splitting, a fact not forced by general connectivity or outerplanar/manifold theorems. Integral attaching maps are certified; field homology alone would not determine them.
